rationale: The closest miss combined two tail-path changes and landed within 0.0003 bpb of the best run. Tail-FC EMA alone already regressed, so this isolates the more credible contributor: a transpose-specific tighter int8 clip for transposed MLP expansion weights. It preserves the current best training dynamics, artifact structure, and quant-aware endgame while directly targeting the final int8 roundtrip error on the columnwise-expanded matrix that motivated the best path.
title: Isolated Transpose Clip On Best Quant Path
